accepted_equivalents.rationale: Line 74 is unreachable-true: accepting a record also requires usa_end <= attributes_offset (the next rule) and attributes_offset < data.len() (the rule after it), which together already give usa_end < data.len(). Narrowing > to == therefore rejects exactly the same records, so no input can distinguish this mutant. The rule is kept because it bounds the untrusted uso/usl pair directly, so relaxing either later rule cannot silently drop the only check keeping the update-sequence array inside the buffer.
